title: QuantiFERON as a named IGRA instance
dek: In-tube ELISA IFN-γ. Wikipedia product/history node. Grey zones and CD4/CD8 tubes are not a CD4 count.
story: Quantiferon on Wikipedia is the commercial in-tube IGRA family (now QFT-Plus in many markets). Blood hits antigen-coated tubes; plasma IFN-γ is an ELISA number with a kit cut-point.
QFT-Plus split tubes marketed around CD4 versus CD8 stimulation are not a clinical CD4 count and not a disease test. The clinic IGRA plate already growled about this; this card names the product.
Nil and mitogen controls are part of the kit logic (indeterminate when the immune system will not talk). That is assay QC, not RIF status.
deep: T-SPOT is the ELISPOT cousin, not a tube ELISA.
Conversion/reversion around the cut-point is noise plus biology; serial-testing protocols live in programmes.
Do not compare IU/mL across kits as if they were a viral load.
BCG still should not drive QFT, because RD1 peptides are the stimulus.

visual.caption: Teaching bars: QFT as an ELISA instance versus T-SPOT as ELISPOT versus TST as skin. Not a meta-analysis.
